notes: Salesforce publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, offices, investment or taxes for FY2025. The 10-K (Item 2) gives about 0.9 million sq ft of leased and owned property in San Francisco used for its offices (plus about 2.1 million sq ft leased to others or available for lease), offices 'in various locations throughout the United States' and in Europe, North America, Asia, South America, Africa and Australia, and co-located data centers in the U.S., Europe and Asia, all without counts. The FY25 Stakeholder Impact Report gives 76,453 global employees with U.S.-only diversity data, and no geographic headcount. The IDC 'Salesforce Economy' white paper commissioned by Salesforce (Dec 2023) has no country table and only gives forecasts to 2028, so it was not used.
